title_candidates: ChatGPT Lockdown Mode gives high-risk users a safer default
summary: OpenAI is rolling out Lockdown Mode, an optional setting that limits web and external-service access to reduce prompt-injection data theft risk.

primary_source.title: Lockdown Mode
primary_source.author: OpenAI Help Center
key_facts: Lockdown Mode is rolling out to eligible personal and self-serve ChatGPT Business accounts.
It limits outbound network requests and related capabilities to reduce data exfiltration risk.
OpenAI says it reduces risk but does not guarantee every prompt-injection effect is impossible.

supporting_sources.title: Introducing Lockdown Mode and Elevated Risk labels in ChatGPT

prerequisites: A reason to handle sensitive information in ChatGPT

steps.instruction: Check Settings for Lockdown Mode, enable it if available, and test which web or connector features are limited.

references.title: Introducing Lockdown Mode and Elevated Risk labels in ChatGPT
references.author: OpenAI

risk_flags: Feature visibility may vary by account during rollout.
